instruction: Manage Y3 and Y4 without further questions; preserve peer work and the storage stop.

Y4.verificationAuthority: Y4's own evidence, not this Y3 snapshot

mainCheckoutObservation.policy: Do not rebase these pinned workstreams onto an unrelated moving source tree during closeout.

mergeRules: Merge only immutable committed peer cuts in a separate integration checkout; never copy unfinished Y4 files or overwrite either worktree.
Preserve Y1 economic, Y3 interaction and Y4 confidential API dispatch, native queue registrations and compute contracts together.
Keep both mounted panels with participant/root/Work identity fences; neither panel replaces the other.
Retain both human-only capability patterns and each family's read classifications.
Retain Y4's exact named-migration bundler exception and Y3's numeric migration/head; regenerate the bundle from both source files.
Regenerate combined OpenAPI, clients, capability manifest, forms, coverage and X source stamps instead of choosing one generated side.
Rebuild source-custody receipts from the final clean combined cut. Neither branch's emitted assets prove the merged tree.
Run both workstreams' final owner, mounted, recovery and reconstruction gates before calling a combined release verified.

sharedStorage.Y3Policy: No installs, API/frontend rebuilds, database campaigns, browser campaigns or fresh reconstruction. Only bounded low-disk closeout artifacts.
